name: Coffee Pub Studio
description: Coffee Pub Studio is a boutique design and development shop. We provoke what's possible and then build it, and the products we make solve real problems for people who plan trips, make streams and run tabletop games.
buildNote: Passion-driven products fueled by coffee, fever dreams, and a chronic lack of sleep.

studioApp.label: Coffee Pub Showrunner
studioApp.text: A free desktop app for macOS and Windows that feeds OBS the sources, audio, video and metadata a streamed game needs. OBS still does the streaming and recording; Showrunner does the setup and the cueing.
